verdict.rationale: LobeHub markets an "IM Gateway — Agents where you already chat," and its usage docs have a dedicated Messenger section with setup pages for Telegram, Slack and Discord. That covers the core of the story: reaching your assistant from everyday messengers rather than only a web page. Missing for 10: any evidence of WhatsApp or iMessage support, detailed doc content beyond the navigation listing, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the gateway works.
